description: FR-M46-01/02 + AC-43 (status.md G-02): the reviewed declaration of registry RPC methods that have no interface consumer. scripts/check-surface-coverage.mjs fails on any orphan not declared here. Entry schema: { method, reason, reviewed: YYYY-MM-DD, mustSurface?: boolean }. `mustSurface: true` marks an instrument that MUST gain an interface consumer — the check keeps failing until one exists (blocking gate, AC-43). Entries without `mustSurface` declare the method unsurfaced-yet-acceptable; `reason` names the phase that will surface it or states that none is planned by design (FR-M46-01).
